tools.name: search_land
tools.description: Search public, non-demo land listings with source links, price basis and observation dates. Defaults to available listings observed within seven days. Price filters default to cash; select a different priceKind explicitly for auction bids, deposits or annual leases.

tools.name: get_land_listing
tools.description: Read one public land listing and its documented, claimed, unknown or conflicting evidence. Private drafts, rejected listings and demo data are unavailable. Current availability must be confirmed with the source.

tools.name: compare_land_listings
tools.description: Compare two to five public listings with source evidence and price basis preserved. This is a factual comparison, not an appraisal, title opinion or guarantee of buildability.

tools.name: read_source_coverage
tools.description: Read public land-source coverage and counts of fresh available non-demo listings. Supports a state filter and pagination. A listed source does not prove nationwide or complete coverage.
